purpose: Teach: 金儲け/とことん/さりげ/ガンガン/ハゲ/音量/見物/ねらい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お小遣い金儲けに使うなよ
lines.en: Don't go turning your allowance into some side hustle, Riku.
lines.style: Dry, slightly mocking tone. Quick delivery with an edge of amusement. The teasing of someone who knows him well enough to call him out without malice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト勉強、とことんやれよ、桜
lines.en: You focus on studying for that test, Sakura. Really buckle down.
lines.style: Measured, almost gentle despite the directness. A quiet insistence wrapped in concern. Steady eye contact level, no performance—just care delivered matter-of-factly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、さりげない優しさあるよな
lines.en: You know, you actually have this quiet way of being kind. It catches you off guard.
lines.style: Softer attack. Genuine realization in the voice, slightly surprised at herself for saying it out loud. Warm but guarded—not gushing, just honest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽ガンガン鳴らすなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't blast music like that. Keep it down, Sakura.
lines.style: Low-key complaint, not nagging. Mild irritation but grounded in something practical—he's actually concerned about the volume. Casual, familiar tone of someone sharing space.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のおじいちゃん、ハゲてんだろ?
lines.style: Teasing, sudden shift in topic. Light curiosity with an undertone of mischief. Quick delivery, testing his reaction. The rhythm of friends who poke at each other.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のスマホ、音量小さくしろよ、桜
lines.en: Keep your phone volume down, would you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter this time, almost resigned. Not angry—just worn from repeating himself. The tone of someone who's given up on being heard but keeps trying anyway.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭の見物、行こうぜ
lines.en: Come on, let's go check out the culture festival together.
lines.style: Upbeat, inviting attack. Genuine enthusiasm beneath the casual invitation. Quick pace, almost eager despite trying to play it cool. The offer of inclusion.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の作戦のねらいは何だ?桜
lines.en: What's the actual point of this plan you're cooking up, Sakura?
lines.style: Narrowed skepticism. Perceptive and slightly suspicious. Slower, more deliberate delivery—he's trying to read her intention. Close attention, no accusation, just genuine curiosity mixed with wariness.
